---
title: "Data dictionary"
---

The canonical data dictionary lives in the **`ikdds-etl`** package
(`redcap_dictionary` + `field_mapping`) and is the single source of truth for every
registry field: REDCap field code, UKRR v5.1 mapping, eMed source column, type,
transform, and validation rules.

The pages below are **auto-generated from that package metadata** by
`ikdds::generate_markdown_docs()` and refreshed by CI whenever the dictionary changes:

- [**Data dictionary**](reference/data-dictionary.md) — every field, grouped by form
- [**Data Requirements Specification (DRS)**](reference/DRS.md) — fields + eMed→REDCap source mappings
- [**Case Report Form (CRF)**](reference/CRF.md) — form-by-form field layout

Machine-readable exports (consumed by `ikdds-nlp` and `ikdds-data-management`):

- [`ikdds_dictionary.yml`](https://github.com/ikddsystem/ikdds-etl/blob/main/inst/dictionary/ikdds_dictionary.yml)
- [`ikdds_dictionary.json`](https://github.com/ikddsystem/ikdds-etl/blob/main/inst/dictionary/ikdds_dictionary.json)
